mapper.select: SELECT c.workflow_id AS workflow_key,v.definition::text AS definition_json,r.config::text AS config_json, r.custom_prompt,p.descriptor::text AS descriptor,r.bindings::text AS bindings_json FROM public.nw_workflow_instances i JOIN public.nw_workflow_installation_revisions r ON r.instance_id=i.id AND r.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND r.installation_revision=#{target.installationRevision} JOIN public.nw_workflow_definition_versions installed ON installed.id=r.definition_version_id AND installed.tenant_id=i.tenant_id JOIN public.nw_workflow_containers c ON c.id=installed.container_id AND c.tenant_id=installed.tenant_id JOIN public.nw_workflow_definition_versions v ON v.id=#{target.instanceRevision} AND v.container_id=c.id AND v.tenant_id=c.tenant_id JOIN public.nw_capability_versions p ON p.id=v.capability_version_id AND p.tenant_id=v.tenant_id WHERE i.tenant_id::text=#{tenant} AND i.id::text=#{target.instanceId} AND i.status='published' AND v.id=#{target.instanceRevision} AND p.id::text=#{target.capability.versionId} AND p.definition_id::text=#{target.capability.capabilityId} AND p.capability_type='WORKFLOW' AND p.status='PUBLISHED' AND jsonb_typeof(v.definition)='object' AND jsonb_typeof(r.config)='object'
